## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] **Clarity:** easy to follow for someone who wasn't involved
- [ ] **Accuracy:** matches what the code does (or will do)
- [ ] **Completeness:** nothing important missing, docs updated with the code
- [ ] **Consistency:** same terms and style as the rest of the docs
